Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka will know that they could have done a lot better had they taken their chances. Dhawan was dropped on 31 and how badly he made them pay. All the bowlers got a hammering as they never bowled good enough to take wickets at regular intervals. However they were much better today. Nuwan Pradeep was the best bowler for them taking 6/132. They have a huge task on their hand. The pitch is starting to deteriorate and the tourists will bank themselves to make early inroads. Join us in a while for their first innings.

A magnificent effort by India after winning the toss and electing to bat. Abhinav Mukund departed early and it seems like it happened ages ago. The pair of Shikhar Dhawan and Cheteshwar Pujara set up the platform with a brisk 253-run stand. Both of them got out after scoring 150-plus but India had the momentum all the while. The lower order chipped in with useful runs and Hardik Pandya scored a fifty on his Test debut to get India 600!

OUT! Kumara gets his third! Short delivery from round the wicket, Pandya goes for the big shot. Mistimes his pull and the ball balloons in the square leg region. Dhananjaya de Silva, the substitute fielder, settles under it and takes a well-judged catch. Sri Lanka have got the final wicket and INDIA ARE ALL OUT FOR 600!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around leg, Yadav tries to defend but gets rapped on the pads.
Umesh Yadav lunges forward and defends it on the off side.
FOUR! Yadav wants his fifty too! Floats this one around off, Umesh gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes that over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Quicker around leg, Yadav gets forward to defend.
Maiden Test fifty for Hardik Pandya!
Floated around leg, Pandya prods forward, pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single. Gets to his maiden Test fifty on debut. Rare sight, this! A brilliant knock from the young all-rounder.
SIX! Boom! Umesh is done watching, he stays in his crease, waits for the fuller ball and crashes that straight down the ground for half a dozen. Even he is interested in the big hits.
Pandya stays in his crease and flat bats it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Back of a length delivery outside off, Pandya stands tall and smacks that through the mid off region for a boundary.
Sprayed down the leg side, Yadav shuffles across. Gets it through backward square leg for a single. So this also the highest total in the first innings by an away team in Sri Lanka.
Again a bouncer into the batsman, Umesh goes for the pull but he fails to make contact.
Short delivery into the batsman, Umesh Yadav stays tall and defends it on the leg side.
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Pandya opts for the aerial route this time. Gets it over the extra cover region for a boundary.
Wide down the leg side, Pandya goes for the sweep but he fails to make contact.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Quicker into the pads, Pandya comes down the track and tries to flick. Gets rapped on the pads.
Shortish in line of the stumps, eased down towards the fielder at long on.
Floats it around off, Hardik Pandya drives it towards the long off fielder.
Welcomes Umesh Yadav with a short one, the batsman tries to sway away from the line of the bouncer. Fails to get away and is hit on his shoulder. That would have hurt.
Umesh Yadav is the last man in.
Drinks.

OUT! Finally the short ball ploy works! Shorter in length around off, Shami looks to go over the leg side with his pull. He miscues it to Upul Tharanga who takes it safely near the ropes at deep mid-wicket. End of a promising stand for India.
Pitched up outside off, Shami drives it on the up towards mid off.
Slower short ball down the leg side, Shami fails to connect with his pull shot.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Shami looks to pull but is beaten. The keeper takes the catch and appeals. Herath wants a review as the umpire says no but the keeper says it is not out.

Good length outside off, Pandya looks to pull but is hit on his body. The bowler appeals but nothing from the umpire as it always looked high. That would have hurt. The batsmen steal a leg bye though.
Change of ends for Lahiru Kumara!
Shorter on middle, Shami goes back and defends it.
SIX! Tossed up around the stumps, Shami comes down the tonks it over the long off fence for a maximum. 150 up for Herath!
Pushes it to covers from his crease.
Flatter around off, Shami brings his bat down in time to defend it.
Lands it on middle and leg, Shami keeps it out.
Floats it around off, Shami looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Rangana Herath is back for a bowl.
Shorter in length around leg, Shami controls his pull to fine leg for a single.
Turns it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
50-run stand between Hardik Pandya and Mohammed Shami!
SIX! Whipped! Angled on the stumps, Pandya gets across and just whips it over backward square leg for a maximum. That was hit with pure disdain and a lot of swag.
Good length around off, Pandya defends it towards long on.
Tad short outside off, Pandya punches it to deep point and refuses the single.
Pandya clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Banged in short, Shami plays a pull and is beaten all ends up.
Good length outside off, Shami defends it towards point.
Shorter in length, Pandya miscues his pull behind square leg for a single.
Shorter in length on middle, Shami controlls his pull shot all along the ground towards deep backward square leg for a single.

Length ball around off, Pandya punches it back down the wicket. The bowler gets a hand to it and deflects it on the stumps at the bowler's end. No harm done since Shami was well inside the crease. The deflection off the stumps gets them a single.
Good length around off, Shami looks to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a single.
Lahiru Kumara returns for a burst.
Same length and this time Shami miscues his pull towards deep mid-wicket for a single. That just lobbed over the infield and fell short of the fielder coming in from the deep.
Shorter in length, another swing and a miss for Shami.
Short and outside off, flayed to deep point for a single.
Wide slip in place for Pandya.
Back of a length around middle and leg, Shami tucks it in front of mid-wicket. Pandya calls him through for a single. Karunaratne looks to have a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Slower short ball on middle and leg, Shami again misses his pull.
Pandya has a word with Shami. No slips in place now. Gully goes to point.
Short but way down the leg side, Shami looks to put it away but misses.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single.
SIX! Go fetch that! Floats it around off, Shami gets under it and launches it over the long off fence for a maximum. They are enjoying their time out there. 550 up for India!
Floats it around off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Clipped wide of the mid on fielder for a run.
Shami comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Flatter on middle, punched towards wide mid on by Shami.
SIX! Another short ball from Pradeep, Pandya is up for it and pulls it over the deep square leg fence for a maximum.
Pitched up outside off, Pandya pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Shorter in length, Shami mistimes his pull towards fine leg for a single. Kumara could not get to it in time to catch that.
Pandya goes back and punches it towards mid on for a single.
Good length outside off, Pandya defends it.

SIX! Into the stands! Shorter in length around off, Pandya was waiting for it and gets it over backward square leg for a biggie. This is now the highest score for India in the first innings of a Test in Sri Lanka.
Drives it through mid off for a single.
Quicker around off, Pandya chops it towards point from his crease.
Flatter around middle, Pandya pushes it towards the outer half of the bat.
Floats it around off, Pandya comes forward and defends it.
Shami drives it through mid off for a single.
SIX! Up and over! Herath bowls it around off, Shami gets under it and just swings it over long on for a maximum. What a hit!
FOUR! Thumped! Shorter in length, this time Pandya just stands tall and pumps it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter in length, Pandya looks to ramp it through but is beaten. Expect a lot more shots.
Fuller around off, Shami just drives it through the mid on region. The ball slows down near the ropes and he gets three runs to get off the mark.
Full and into the stumps, Shami gets across and keeps it out.
Mohammed Shami is the penultimate man in. A leg gully in place for him.

OUT! Pradeep, you beauty! Yorker on off and middle, Jadeja looks to clip it through but misses the ball. It clatters into the stumps and that is it for Jadeja. He has been worked over brilliantly here. Best figures in First Class cricket for Nuwan. The umpire asks Jadeja to wait to check for the no ball but replays find him fine. Brilliant, just brilliant by Pradeep.
Ravindra Jadeja has been bowled. The umpire tells him to wait to check if the bowler has overstepped.

Snorter! Shorter in length around off and middle, Jadeja looks to ride the bounce and fend it away but the ball bounces more on the southpaw and is caught in an awkward tangle. The keeper collects but only the bowler is the one appealing. What a ball though!
Fuller around off, Pandya comes forward and blocks it towards the leg side.
Stands tall and punches it to long on for a single.
This one comes in after pitching, Jadeja defends it off his back foot.
Flatter on middle and leg, turned towards short leg by Ravindra.
Jadeja prods forward and defends it watchfully.
Floats it around off, Pandya sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a single. Pradeep covered good ground to stop it near the fence at square leg.
Shorter in length around middle, Pandya looks to ramp it but misses. The keeper fumbles and allows a bye. Sloppy work!
Short one again but way down the leg side, wobbles away as the keeper dives to his left and stops it.

FOUR! Top edged! Shorter in length, Pandya goes for the pull. He gets a top edge which flies over the keeper for a boundary. That wasn't far from the boundary ropes and was almost a six. Morale victory for the bowler.
Cuts it to deep point for a single.
Wider outside off, Jadeja looks to flay it away but misses.
Wide outside off, left alone.

DROPPED! Floats it outside off, Pandya pushes at it from his crease. The ball takes the outside edge and flies quickly to first slip. Dimuth Karunaratne reacts a touch late and ends up spilling it. That should have been gobbled. Pandya was walking but spotted that he has got a life. Herath won't be happy.
Loopy on middle, Pandya comes forward and defends it.
Shorter and outside off, Pandya shapes to cut it away but misses.
Floats it on middle, Pandya lunges forward and defends it.
Slants it down the leg side, Jadeja lets it go. The keeper fumbles and allows a bye.
Lands it outside off, spins in, Herath stays back and defends it.
Rangana Herath to bowl from the other end.
Shorter in length, Pandya was waiting for it and sits underneath it well in time.
Angled on the body of the batsman, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Jadeja.
Shorter in length around middle and leg, Jadeja lets it go after thinking to pull at first. No point bowling this after taking out the leg slip.
Good length outside off, punched to cover-point by Jadeja.
No leg slip after the boundary, extra protection on the off side now.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Good length outside off, Jadeja punches it nicely off the back foot and gets a boundary to covers. Expect nothing else from these two.

The players are out in the middle for play. Hardik Pandya and Ravindra Jadeja are out to bat. Sri Lanka start the session with Nuwan Pradeep. Should be interesting to see how India bat in this session. A slip in place for him along with a leg slip.
.... Day 2, Session 2 ....

104 runs, 4 wickets - Session in favor of Sri Lanka? Marginally maybe! The home side will be delighted with their work today. Pradeep led the way once again taking two important wickets. Both Pujara and Rahane could not do much but Ashwin chipped in with a fine 47 to drive his side ahead. Herath and Kumara took a wicket each to keep India in check. The tourists though will be happy with the score they have, they will look to get over 600 and then see from there. Sri Lanka will want to keep taking wickets. Join us in a while for the second session.
Fires this one in the line of the stumps, Hardik defends it neatly. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Floated outside off, Pandya lunges forward and defends it.
Angling into the pads, tucked in front of square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Jadeja gets to the pitch of the ball and defends.
Around off, Ravindra defends it towards the fielder at slip.
FOUR! Shortish outside off, Jadeja stays deep in his crease and punches it through the cover region for a boundary.
Hardik Pandya stays in his crease and defends it towards point.
Jadeja glides it through the point region for a single. The umpire has a talk with Jadeja about his running between the wickets. The umpire gives him an official warning.

Good length delivery outside off, Jadeja dabs it towards the fielder at point and calls for a single. The gully fielder chases it down and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He hits but Jadeja is well in, the ball deflects through the mid-wicket region for another run.
Length delivery around off, Ravindra stays back and blocks it away neatly.
Good length delivery around off, Jadeja gets behind the line of the ball and defends it towards covers.
Ravindra Jadeja is the next man in.

OUT! Pradeep gets his fifer! Comes around the wicket and bowls a short delivery down the leg side. Ashwin goes for the pull, ends up gloving it and the ball flies through to the keeper. Dickwella accepts it gleefully and the Indian offie has to start walking just three runs short of the fifty. A good innings comes to an end. Nuwan gets his first fifer of his Test career.
A bit shortish around off, Pandya punches it towards the fielder at mid off.
Fuller around off, Pandya drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! First runs in Test cricket for Pandya! Hardik is done watching, steps out to the floated delivery around off and smacks that through the mid on region for a boundary.
Pandya lunges forward and  defends it again.
Floated around middle and off, Hardik Pandya prods forward and defends it neatly.
Debutant Hardik Pandya makes his way out to the middle. He will look to impress on his Test debut.

OUT! Herath strikes and gets his first of the match! Tossed up around leg, Saha steps out and tries to go downtown. Hits it straight to the fielder at mid on. Dilruwan Perera pouches a safe catch and Wriddhiman has to walk back to the hut. It's taken 32 overs to land the Sri Lankan skipper his first wicket.
Rangana Herath calls himself back for a bowl.
Fuller around off, Ashwin drives it towards covers. The fielder there goes to his right and makes a good stop.
Length delivery angling in from outside off, Ravichandran gets behind the line of the ball and defends it well.
Wide! Dug in really short this time, Ashwin lets the ball sail over him this time. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ashwin stands tall and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Length delivery around off, Ashwin guides it towards the fielder at gully.
Ashwin gets forward and defends it neatly.

CHANCE! Fuller around leg, Ashwin flicks it towards the fielder at leg gully. Kusal Mendis the fielder there collects it quickly and has a shy at the striker's end. He misses but had he hit, Ashwin would have been gone. The batsmen run a couple on overthrows.
Nuwan Pradeep is back for a bowl.
FOUR! Powerful! Floated around off, Saha kneels and sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Quicker around off and middle, Saha comes forward and blocks it on the leg side.
Floated outside off, Ashwin drives it through covers for another single.
Shortish around off, Saha punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
50-run stand Ravichandran Ashwin and Wriddhiman Saha!
Floated outside off, Ravichandran prods forward in defence. Gets it off the outer half through point for a single.
Spilled down the leg side, Ashwin defends it on the leg side.
Dug in short this time around middle and leg, Wriddhiman sits under that bumper.
Short and wide outside off, Saha shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller around middle and off, Saha clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
Full around off, Ashwin digs it out through the point region for a single.
Sprayed full and down the leg side at a slower pace, Ashwin defends it towards the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery around off, Ashwin gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Saha prods forward and defends it neatly.
Floated around off, Saha drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Full into the pads, Ashwin flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller into the pads, Ashwin clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Ravichandran lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Sprayed down the leg side, Ashwin plays the paddle scoop, past the keeper for a couple.
Dug in short down the leg side, Saha ducks under the bumper.
Good length delivery around off, Saha punches it back to the bowler.
Fuller around off, Ashwin drives it back to the bowler. Kumara tries to stop it, ends up diverting it towards extra cover for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Ashwin ducks under it.
Outside off, Saha chops it through point for a single.
FOUR! Dug in short outside off, Saha stays tall and tries to fend it away. Gets it off the splice, over the slip fielder's head for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Top shot! Again tossed up outside off, Ashwin fancies his elegant drive through covers for a boundary.
Quicker around off this time, Ashwin pushes it straight back to the bowler.
Again floated outside off, Ashwin plays a drive through covers. The deep point fielder cuts it off and the batsmen run a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Saha reaches out to it, drives it through covers for a single.
Around off on a shortish length, Ashwin punches it towards long on for a single.
Three short balls in a row, Saha choses to duck underneath it again. Such bowling is never going to land you a wicket.
Another short delivery into the batsman, Saha sits under that bumper.
Short delivery around off, Saha choses to duck underneath it.
Fuller around middle and leg, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Wriddhiman prods forward and defends it towards covers.
Good length delivery angling around off, Saha gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Tossed up around off, Ashwin stays in his crease and punches it back down the track.
Fuller around off, Ashwin prods forward and defends it.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Ashwin waits for it and fancies a late cut, gets it past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit short around off, Ashwin camps back and defends it neatly.

Loud appeal not given! Floated outside off, Ashwin shuffles, covers his stumps and tries to let it through. The ball spins in late and nicks his front pad. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested as the ball did not turn enough. Spin for the off spinner too, interesting.
Dilruwan Perera is brought back for a bowl.
Now fuller into the pads, Ashwin just clips it elegantly through the mid-wicket region. The fielder gives it a chase and saves a run for his team.
FOUR! Fuller outside off, Ashwin leans into the drive and creams it through the point region. The backward point fielder gives it a chase but the ball wins the race to the fence.
Fuller around off, Ravichandran drives it towards mid on. No runs taken.
Angling into the hips, Ashwin shuffles a bit and tucks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length delivery around off, Ashwin stays tall and pushes it towards mid on.
Short delivery into the batsman, Saha tries to fend it away. Gets an inside edge to it and the ball goes wide of short leg for a single. Not comfortable there, Saha.
Drinks! A decent session of play for the home side, they have conceded 52 runs but have also taken a couple of wickets to boost their confidence. India will want to bat on and on and on.
Ashwin prods forward and defends it.
Slices it towards point from his crease.
Lunges forward and pushes it to short cover.
FOUR! Excellent! Herath bowls it outside off, Ashwin strides forward and drives it through covers yet again for a boundary. He is really batting well.
Flatter on the pads now, turned through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Sublime! Floats it around off, Ashwin presses forward and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Saha comes forward and defends it.
Length outside off, Saha pushes at it from his crease but is beaten.
Bouncer! Short again from Kumara, Saha is happy to sit under it. Signaled wide by the umpire.
FOUR! Timing! Fullish around off, Saha presents the full face of the bat and gets it through mid on for a boundary. Good shot that from Saha despite the short one that he received before this.
Shorter in length around middle, Saha ducks.
Good length outside off, Saha punches it towards covers.
Fuller around off, clipped towards mid on from his crease.
Tossed up around off, Ashwin comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Nice shot! Floats it around the stumps, Ashwin comes down and clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was nicely hit.
Pushes it towards mid off from his crease.
Floats it around off, Ashwin defends it.
Looks to drive but gets it off the outer half towards point.
Ashwin comes forward and blocks this one.
Saha takes the bottom hand off the bat and defends this short ball around off. Well played, that. Wicket maiden for Kumara.
A deep short leg in place.
Back of a length around off, Saha gets into an awkward tangle but defends it well.
Length ball outside off, Saha comes forward and defends it.
Shorter length outside off, left alone by Saha.
Yorker first up to Saha, dug out by the batsman watchfully.
Wriddhiman Saha is the next man in.

OUT! Kumara strikes at last after being wayward all day yesterday! He bowls it full and outside off, Rahane looks to drive it through but gets an outside edge towards first slip. Dimuth Karunaratne takes a good catch to his right. That is a very good start to the day for Lahiru. Rahane will feel he threw away his wicket there.
Break for Pradeep, Lahiru Kumara brought on for a bowl.
Flatter around middle, Ashwin stays back and defends it.
Ashwin turns it towards the leg side from his crease.
Floats it around off, Ashwin comes forward and defends it.
Ashwin opens the face and pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Rahane turns it through mid on for a single.
Floats it around middle, Rahane comes down to play but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The short leg fielder cannot get to it.
Full and outside off, Ashwin presses forward and plays a lovely cover drive. The fielder at covers gets a hand to it and stops it from going through. Two runs taken.
Slants it down the leg side, Ashwin fails to clip it away.
Leg gully in place.
Length ball outside off, pushed into covers.
FOUR! Top shot! Length ball outside off, Ashwin punches it on the up through covers for a majestic boundary. That was superbly timed.
Good length around off, Ashwin stands tall and defends it.
Fuller around off from wide of the crease, turns through backward square leg for a single.
Darts one down the leg side, Ashwin looks to work it through the leg side but is beaten. The keeper looks to take the bails off but Ashwin never left the crease.
Ashwin prods forward and defends one back down the wicket.
Around off, turned through mid on for a single.
Rahane presses forward and smothers this one into the wicket.
Tossed up around off, Rahane comes down to play but mistimes it back down the wicket.
Floats it around middle, Rahane comes forward and blocks it.
Good length outside off, Ashwin looks to play it square of the wicket but is beaten all ends up.
EDGED! Back of a length around middle, Ashwin hangs his bat at it. The ball goes off the edge but falls short of the fielder at gully. Pradeep has bowled his heart out here.
Ravichandran Ashwin strides out to the middle.

OUT! Pradeep takes another one! Nuwan bowls one in the area just outside off, Pujara has to play at it but the ball straightens after pitching. It goes off the outside edge and Dickwella accepts the catch. Commentator's curse maybe. End of a brilliant, brilliant knock by Cheteshwar Pujara though. He gets a rousing reception from his teammates. Sri Lanka owe the success to Pradeep.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, unlike Kohli and Rahane, Pujara is happy to leave it all alone. He has been pretty good throughout and has hardly played a false shot.
Good length outside off, punched through point from Rahane.
Angling around off, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Turns it towards mid on from his crease.
Comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Punches it through covers for a couple.
12th Test fifty for Ajinkya Rahane!

FOUR! Hammered! Tossed up around off, Rahane slinks down the wicket and clobbers it through mid on for a boundary. He has played well so far and will want to convert this fifty. Maiden one against Sri Lanka, to go along with a century. 100 up for Herath!
Floats it around middle, defended in front of short leg.
Darted around middle, Rahane comes down and mistimes his push towards mid on.
Length around off, Pujara comes forward and blocks it.
Shortish and wide outside off, left alone by Pujara.
Length ball around off, Pujara defends it watchfully.
Fuller outside off, Pujara comes forward and pushes it into covers.
Similar ball but wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Played, Che! Pradeep goes wide of the crease, angles it around the stumps, Pujara tucks it nicely to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Brings up his 6th score of over 150 in Tests!
Floats it around middle, turned towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Fuller around off, turned towards mid on for a single.
Arm ball around middle, Rahane comes down and pushes it towards mid off for a quick single. Well run, that.
Flatter around middle and leg, Rahane goes back and defends it.
Comes down and bunts one back to the bowler who fumbles but no harm done.
Rahane stays back and defends it watchfully.
Back of a length outside off, played towards point by Rahane for a single.
FOUR! Classical! Pradeep bowls a length ball outside off, expecting Rahane to have his weight back. Ajinkya though is up for it and drives it on the rise through covers for a boundary. Good stuff!

Bouncer! Almost did a Kohli, Rahane! Shorter in length around middle and leg, Rahane goes for the pull before pulling out of the shot at the last moment. He nearly lost his balance too and fell down. Well bowled by Pradeep.
Good length outside off, Rahane comes forward and defends it.
Rahane strides forward and pushes it into covers.
Good length around off, played towards gully by Rahane.
Interestingly, Rangana Herath is the man who has used the most number of reviews ever since DRS has come into the game. He has a 20 percent success rate.
Floats it around off, Pujara gets in line and defends it. Maiden for Herath as well.
Loopy around middle, Pujara comes forward and defends it in front of the short leg fielder.
Fuller around the stumps, worked towards mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, pushed into the covers.
Pujara comes forward and nudges it towards the short leg fielder.

NOT OUT! Floats it around off, spins a touch, Pujara plays inside the line of the ball and is beaten all ends up. The keeper collects the ball and appeals. The umpire says no though. Sri Lanka go for the review. Ultra Edge detects nothing and that is not out. There was visible turn on offer and that excited the players. India won't mind that actually. They would rather enjoy watching the ball turn. Nice start!
Sri Lanka have gone upstairs to take a review for caught behind against Cheteshwar Pujara.
Just an over then for Dilruwan, Rangana Herath brings himself on for a bowl.
Fuller outside off, Rahane comes forward and drives it towards mid off. Maiden to begin with for Pradeep.
Good length angling around off, Rahane turns in his crease and tucks it towards the leg side.
Flashy! Short and wide outside off, this time Rahane feels for it and throws his bat at it. The ball whizzes past the bat and the players appeal in vain.
Similar length, closer to the stumps but still wide enough for an easy leave.
Very wide outside off, no shot offered.
Good length outside off, left alone by Rahane.
Nuwan Pradeep to run in from the other end. Two slips and a gully in place.
Around leg, turned through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Nothing threatening in that over.
Rahane tucks one through backward square leg for a single.
Loopy around middle, Rahane comes down the wicket and hits one towards mid on. That was nicely done.
Floats it around middle, Rahane comes forward and defends it.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it around off, Pujara comes down and nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
A run to begin! Tossed up around off, Rahane lunges and turns it through mid-wicket for a single. 400 up for India.

Game time! The players are out in the middle. Cheteshwar Pujara and Ajinkya Rahane stride out to continue batting. Sri Lanka will want an early wicket, Dilruwan Perera to start the day for them. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...

Pitch report - Russel Arnold reckons that there are rough areas developing but the pitch will be good to bat on though. Opines that it was not a 399/3 deck and Sri Lanka bowled poorly. He adds that the bowlers need to be fuller and make the batsmen feel uncomfortable. He ends by saying that spinners will get more purchase as the day progresses, as obvious as the sun rising in the east.

FOUR! Again a freebie! Spilt down the leg side, Dhawan sweeps it again through the backward square leg region for a boundary. Second boundary of the over.
A bit short this time, Dhawan camps back and punches it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Easy, easy, easy pickings! Way down the leg side, Dhawan loves that line, sweeps it away past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Fuller around off, Pujara shows his front foot defence.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara prods forward and defends.
Shortish around off, Che dabs it towards the point fielder.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara gets to the pitch of the ball to defend.
A bit short and spinning in, Dhawan stays in his crease and punches it towards long on for a single.
Fuller around leg, clipped towards mid-wicket by Dhawan.
Rangana Herath returns for a bowl. He will aim to provide a breakthrough. Sri Lanka need it rather desperately.
Drinks.
Lands it around leg, clipped to long on for a single.
Nudges one behind square on the leg side for a single. 200 up for India, already.
Cheteshwar hits one back to the bowler from his crease.
Pujara slinks down the wicket and turns it towards mid on.
Comes down and hits it towards mid on.
Floats it around off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
Yorker from round the wicket, Dhawan keeps it out. His figures read 9-0-65-0!

FOUR! Nothing is working! Mathews had a word with his teammate there but to no avail. Short and wide outside off, Shikhar Dhawan just stands tall and dispatches it through sweeper cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Full toss on the pads, Dhawan pumps it wide of the deep backward square leg region for a boundary. Already 10 runs of the over, mentions the commentator.
Shorter in length again, tucked to long leg for a run.
Shorter in length, Dhawan controls his pull down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Hit away! Short and wide outside off, Dhawan smashes it to the deep point fence. Sri Lanka are asking to be hit around the park here.
Works one towards mid on from his crease.
Tucks one towards fine leg for a single.
Lands it outside leg, Dhawan pads it away.
Is that out? Lands it around leg, Dhawan looks to sweep but misses. The keeper fumbles and then takes the bails off, appeals for a stumping but the square leg umpire dismisses it.
This time he plays the sweep shot but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Fuller on leg, Dhawan comes down and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Fuller outside off, driven towards covers by the batsman.
Shorter in length again, Pujara ducks under it. No ball signaled for the height again. Just sums up the day for Sri Lanka so far.
Another bumper, another duck by Cheteshwar. Wide signaled for the height on that one.
Shorter in length, a rarity, Pujara ducks under it.
FOUR! What a shot that is! Kumara bowls it around off, Pujara just gets across a touch and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. This is superb batting. Session run rate so far is 6.38!
150-run stand between Dhawan and Pujara.
16th Test fifty for Cheteshwar Pujara!
FOUR! Played, Pujara! Full toss outside off, Pujara creams it through the covers for a boundary. The runs are flowing at ease for India.
Good length outside off, Pujara almost loses balance trying to defend that into the off side.
Top timing! Lands it outside off, Pujara comes down and flicks it with the turn wide of mid on. The ball slows down near the ropes. Three runs taken.
Lands it outside off, left alone by Pujara.
Pujara comes down and turns it through mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, clipped through mid on for a single.
Comes forward and nudges one towards short mid-wicket from his crease.
FOUR! Sweet! Short and wide outside off, Dhawan goes back and angles it past backward point for a boundary. Shikhar is all smiles and why not. He has enjoyed his batting.
Short and around off, Dhawan cuts it to deep point for a single.
Kumara lands it around off, Pujara mistimes his push towards mid on. He calls Dhawan through for a quick single.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single. The cover fielder got a hand to it and hence it allowed the fielder in the deep to mop it up.
Shorter outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Fuller around off, Dhawan comes forward and defends it to sweeper cover for a single.
Lahiru Kumara is brought back for a bowl.
Full and outside off, Shikhar comes down and pushes it through mid off for a single.

What happened there? Perera spots Dhawan coming and darts one outside off. Dhawan gets a bottom edge but ensures that he gets back into his crease in time to not get stumped. He does not want to waste this chance.
CLOSE! Pujara walks forward and turns one wide of the short leg fielder for a single. That wasn't far from the fielder.
Floats it around off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
Shorter around off, punched to long on for a single.
5th Test hundred for Shikhar Dhawan!

FOUR! CENTURY! Dhawan is back and how! Dilruwan bowls it around off, Shikhar gets down on it and sweeps it through the backward square leg region for a boundary. He celebrates it in his usual way, his second ton at this venue. He has been absolutely magnificent today. Remember he was dropped on 31, it has cost the home side dearly.
Full and outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
Shorter around off, controlled pull to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Pujara punches it through the covers. The cover fielder gets to it and saves a run for his side. Mathews was the fielder there.
Short ball around off, pulled to deep fine leg for a single. 150 up for India.
A tad short around off, defended off the back foot.
The second slip fielder moves to point now.
FOUR! Dhawan power! Short and wide outside off, Dhawan cuts it hard and behind deep point for a boundary. Races away to 95!
Shikhar dances down and turns it through mid on for a single. Just like that, he is on 91 in 105 balls.
Dhawan comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Shorter around off, punched towards covers by the batsman.
The extra cover fielder is now moved to short fine leg.
FOUR! Deft! Shorter outside off, Dhawan camps back and just glides behind backward point for a boundary. This is all too easy.
Lands it around off, Dhawan comes forward to push towards covers and wants a run but is sent back.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard! Floats it around off, Dhawan comes down on it and sweeps it hard in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Cheteshwar defends it from his crease.
Good length around off, Pujara defends it watchfully.
Angles in a good length ball outside off, Pujara stands tall and defends it.
Fuller around off, turned towards mid on from his crease.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Good length around off, Pujara defends it towards the leg side.
Dhawan comes down the track and plays it back down the wicket.
Prods forward and pushes this one towards point.
FOUR! Too easy! Floated outside off, Dhawan comes down the track and smacks it through the gap between the two fielders at covers for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, cut towards backward point by Dhawan.
Lands it around off, Dhawan comes forward and defends it.
Floats it around off, Puajra turns it towards mid-wicket. The fielder has a needless shy at the striker's end and the deflection results in a run.
Big blow for Sri Lanka - Asela Gunaratne won't take any further part in this Test match. He has fractured his left thumb. This could be a really big loss for the Sri Lankan side.
Dilruwan Perera is called back for a bowl.
Length ball angling in, Dhawan stands tall and turns it towards the leg side.
Length outside off, Dhawan gets across and defends it towards the off side.
Another confident leave by Dhawan.
Good length outside off, left alone by Shikhar.
Full and outside off, too wide for a shot by Dhawan.
FOUR! All in control! Shorter in length, Dhawan gets on top of it, rolls his wrists over it and gets it to the deep square leg fence for a boundary. Mathews in the deep did not spot it at all.
Another delay due to sightscreen.
100-run stand between Dhawan and Pujara.
Easy! Nudges this one through backward square leg for a single. India have been dominant against Herath. Also brings up the century stand!
FOUR! Herath is being hit out! This time Dhawan goes to the left of the bowler and smashes this one down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Shot of the day! Herath bowls it outside off, Dhawan strides out of his crease, just punches his drive wide of mid off for a boundary. Superb timing, even better placement!
Too full around off, Dhawan comes down but can only hit it back to the bowler all along the ground.
Lands it around off, Dhawan comes forward and defends it.
Good stop! Floated outside off, Pujara comes down a touch and looks to drive. The fielder at short covers gets a hand to it and parries it towards mid off. A single taken.

Rangana Herath to bowl from the other end. It is going to be important to not let India run away with the scoring rate. For some reason, there is an issue with the sightscreen. Things like these are really needless. In 2017, yet we can't get rid of these petty issues.
Angles it on the stumps, Pujara works it off the inner half through backward square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, cracked to deep point for a single.
Good length outside off, Dhawan is watchful as he lets it go.
Shikhar comes forward and pushes it towards covers.

Is that out? Nope! Good length around off, comes in a long way, Dhawan shapes to clip but is hit on his pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Herath ponders about the review but does not go for it. That looked high.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan comes forward and defends it.

Play time! Shikhar Dhawan and Cheteshwar Pujara stride out to bat. They will aim to carry on the good work while the hosts will look for some wickets to keep them in check. They begin the proceedings with Nuwan Pradeep! Here we go...
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

An excellent session of play for India. They have done nothing wrong except losing the wicket of Abhinav Mukund. Shikhar Dhawan and Cheteshwar Pujara are looking really comfortable in the middle as the Lankan bowlers have not been disciplined and bowled too many poor balls. The former who got a life earlier has already gone past his fifty and is looking all set for a big knock. Rangana Herath will have a lot of thinking to do as India are going at a really good rate. Join us in a while for the second session.
Quicker around leg, Pujara gets forward and defends it. That's LUNCH, Day 1!
Another shortish delivery around off, Dhawan stays deep in his crease, pushes it through point for a single.
Full toss outside off, flicked towards wide mid on for a single.
A bit short around off, Dhawan dabs it through the point region for a single.
Fuller around off, Dhawan nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Cheteshwar Pujara whips it through the mid-wicket region. The fielder gives it a chase and saves a run for his team.
Rangana Herath to bowl the last over before lunch.
Floated outside off, Dhawan prods forward and defends it.
A bit short down the leg side, Pujara stays back and clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller around off, Pujara dances down the track and drills it towards mid off. No runs taken.
Pujara comes down the track again and clips it on the leg side. Cannot get it past the mid-wicket fielder.
Floated around off, Cheteshwar comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler. Perera dives to his left and makes a really good stop.
Shortish outside off, Dhawan punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Dhawan stays in his crease and defends it towards cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Fuller down the leg side, Dhawan kneels down and brings out the sweep. Gets it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! Dhawan charges down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it hard past the bowler for a boundary.
Floated around middle and off, Dhawan comes down the track and defends it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Dhawan jams it towards the fielder at silly mid on.
Short around leg, Pujara clips it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Into the pads, Dhawan flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Dhawan dances down the track, reaches to the pitch of the ball and smacks that along the ground back to the bowler.
Into the pads, clipped to square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, Che gets forward and unleashes his drive towards the fielder at mid off.
Tossed up around off, Dhawan gets forward, defends it towards covers and rushes for a quick single.
Fuller around leg, Dhawan comes forward and blocks it back to the bowler.
Quicker into the pads, Pujara stays deep and defends it in front of the fielder at short leg.
Cheteshwar comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller around leg, Pujara lunges forward and defends it on the leg side.
Around middle and leg, Pujara gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Dhawan flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller around off, Dhawan drills it back to the bowler.
4th Test fifty for Shikhar Dhawan!

Well played, Shikhar! Floated outside off, Dhawan gets forward and eases it down to long off for a single. The Indian opener is making the most of the opportunity and he will look to get a big score this time around.
Cheteshwar comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker around off, Pujara gets it off the open face of the bat past the slip fielder for a couple.
Pujara lunges forward and defends it well.
Floated outside off, Pujara dances down the track and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shortish around off, punched towards wide long off for a single.
Around off again, Pujara lunges forward and defends it off the inside edge.
Floated around off, Pujara gets forward and blocks it with ease.
Sprayed down the leg side, Pujara adjusts a bit and plays it really fine past the keeper on the leg side for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around middle and leg, Pujara gets a bit forward, clips but straight to mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Pujara gets forward and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
A tad short outside off, Dhawan cuts but straight towards the fielder at backward point.
Fuller around middle and leg, Dhawan lunges forward and defends.
Spinning in from around middle and off, Pujara shuffles a bit and clips it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Quicker outside off, Pujara gets forward and pads it away.
Floated around leg, Dhawan dances down the track and drives it through the wide mid off region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Dhawan gets forward and defends it.
Dilruwan Perera comes back on.
Fuller into the pads, Pujara clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Pujara gets forward and to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Flighted around off, Pujara prods forward in defence.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Pujara gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Fuller around leg, Dhawan drives it to long on for a single.
Floats this one outside off, Dhawan gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Skipper Rangana Herath introduces himself into the attack. He will hope to make an impact early as the Indian batsmen look settled in the middle.
Another short delivery, Dhawan pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Kumara is all charged up! Fuller delivery around middle and off, Dhawan drives it back to the bowler. Lahiru collects it and has a shy back at the striker's end. No damage done in the end.
Fuller and into the stumps, Dhawan gets behind it to block it away.
FOUR! Good shot! Another delivery banged in short, Dhawan camps back, rides the bounce and pulls it with authority through the square leg region for a boundary.
50-run stand between Dhawan and Pujara.
Angling in from a good length, Pujara clips it through mid-wicket for a single.

Pujara pulls out at the last moment. The bowler does not like that. But even Pujara is not happy with the reaction of Lahiru Kumara and he lets that known to the umpire. The batsman pulled out due to a problem with the sightscreen.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhawan defends it towards point and calls for a quick single.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara races down the track and whips it towards the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Dragged short down the leg side, Pujara stays in his crease and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Dhawan camps back and punches it towards cover-point for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Another tossed up delivery around middle and off, Pujara gets forward to defend. Gets an inside edge on it and the ball runs down towards short fine leg for a single.
Floated around off, Pujara gets to the pitch of the ball and defends.
Spills this one into the pads, Dhawan is quick to flick it through the backward square leg region. Nuwan Pradeep is able to cut it off this time. The batsmen run a couple in the process.
Bangs this short outside off, Dhawan thinks of playing the upper cut but lets it through at the very last moment.

The umpire inspects the area Kumara is following through on. Sri Lanka are already playing with fire here with their bowlers. Kumara has struggled and also has a warning for a beamer, Gunaratne has gone off. Pradeep does not seem 100 percent fit. Troubled times!
Short delivery outside off, Dhawan stands tall and punches it towards the fielder at sweeper cover for a couple.
Length delivery around off, Dhawan mistimes his drive towards the fielder at mid off.
On a good length outside off, Dhawan makes a leave this time.
Length delivery around middle and leg, Dhawan stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
Flighted around off, Dhawan goes for the sweep this time, gets it towards fine leg for a single. Five singles off the over.
Floated around leg, Dhawan looks to flick but fails to connect. That had the close-in fielders excited.
A bit shortish around middle and leg, Pujara clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Floated around off, Dhawan comes down the track and eases it down towards long off for a single.
Again sprayed around middle and leg, Pujara shuffles across and nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
Angling into the pads, Dhawan tickles it fine towards short fine leg for a single.
Hold up in play as Gunaratne gets some medical attention. He looks in a lot of pain. The entire Sri Lankan team is around him. Oh dear, he is walking off holding his left wrist.

Dropped! Length delivery outside off, Dhawan leans into the drive. Gets a thick outside edge on it and the ball flies towards second slip. Asela Gunaratne dives to his left, gets his hand to it but fails to hold onto it. A regulation catch goes down and it might be costly one. Kumara is disappointed and the batsmen run a single. Gunaratne goes crashing down in pain.

No ball! What's happened there? Kumara comes charging in and tries to bowl an effort ball. Unfortunately it slips out of his hand and he ends up dishing out a beamer straight on the body of the batsman. Dhawan ducks under it and Dickwella has a tough time stopping it. He just managed to stop it on the bounce. A warning given to Kumara.
Good length delivery around off, Dhawan gets behind the line of the ball and punches it towards covers.

FOUR! Easy pickings! Fuller into the pads, Dhawan whips it through the backward square leg region. Nuwan Pradeep goes to his right from fine leg to stop the ball but hesitates to slide and hence fails to prevent the boundary.
Another back of a length delivery, holds a bit on the pitch. Dhawan manages to fend it away on the leg side.
FOUR! Shot! Short delivery into the batsman, Dhawan stays in his crease and pulls it through the fine leg region for a boundary.

Fuller delivery outside off, Pujara drives it towards covers. Rangana Herath gets behind the ball but is beaten by the awkward bounce. Gets deceived by it and the ball goes through. The batsmen run three in the process.
Lahiru Kumara returns for a bowl. He wasn't at his best in his first spell.

Drinks on the field. An easy passage of play for India. Mukund would rue missing out on an opportunity to score big on a placid deck. There were a few nervy moments just before the break for the pair at the crease. Pujara was seen holding his left shoulder. India will hope he is fit enough.
Dhawan and Pujara need to talk! Another punch to point, another single initiated but not taken. Both the batsmen need to have a word and sort out the communication.
Pushes it towards point.

Confusion! Shorter in length around off, Dhawan punches it towards point and takes off. Pujara responds but Shikhar sends him back late. Had the throw been a good one at the bowler's end even Pujara's dive would not have been enough. Really close call.
Fuller around off, Shikhar comes forward and blocks it.
Floats it around off, Dhawan comes down to push and run a single but sends back Pujara who was anticipating it as well.
And again, Dhawan comes down and pushes one towards covers.
Good length around off, Pujara defends it from his crease.
Good length outside off, punched into covers by the batsman.
FOUR! Put away! Pradeep drifts it into the pads, Pujara won't miss out on such balls as he clips it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pradeep slips while trying to deliver the ball. Hopefully he is fine. Didn't land well there and almost twisted his left ankle.
Wide enough for a leave for Pujara.

CLOSE! Length ball around off, Pujara comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball threatens to go towards the stumps but the batsman is aware to it and keeps it out. That came in sharply into Pujara and hence he got an inside edge.
Shorter in length outside off, Pujara watches the ball sail over him. Good ball but far too wide.
Floats it around off, Dhawan prods forward and blocks it.
Floats it around off, Pujara comes down a touch and flicks it to the right of the mid on fielder for a single.
A tad short around off, punched towards short mid-wicket by the batsman.
Floats it around off, Pujara comes forward and blocks it.
Lands it around off, Pujara presents the full face of the bat and defends it.
Dhawan clips one to the left of mid on for a single. He has not allowed the bowlers to bowl to him so far.
Good length around off, nudged past the diving short leg fielder for a couple of runs.
Back of a length outside off, nips back in, too wide for Pujara to play a shot. Pradeep is not happy, maybe he wanted to bowl it closer to the stumps.
Back of a length around off, comes in, Pujara defends it from his crease.
Good length outside off, Pujara shapes to defend but gets it off the outer half towards the off side.
Good length outside off, Pujara punches it into covers.
Length ball outside off, Dhawan gets across and taps it into covers for a single. He has been busy right from the start.
Pujara comes forward and defends it from his crease off the inner half towards the leg side.
Well bowled! Loopy around the stumps, Pujara is beaten in the air as he looks to come down and whip it through the leg side. The ball goes off the pads towards the off side. Good ball, that.
Floats it around off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
Fuller around off, worked to mid on for a single.
Shorter around off, Dhawan punches it past the diving cover fielder for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Thumped! Floats it around off, Dhawan comes down and spanks it through wide mid off for a boundary. Superb shot, that.
Good length around off, Pujara defends it from his crease.
FOUR! Edged! Good length just outside off, Pujara is surprised by the bounce so plays it with soft hands. The edge does not carry and runs into the third man fence.
Back of a length just around off, Pujara stands tall and defends it.
Cheteshwar Pujara makes his way out to the middle. He had a good time the last time he played a Test here.

OUT! Poor shot! Length ball outside off, Mukund hangs his bat out for it. The ball takes the edge and carries to the keeper. An easy catch for Dickwella and Abhinav continues to not make the most of the chances presented to him. A timely wicket for Sri Lanka. The change of ends works for Pradeep.
A tad closer to the stumps, another confident leave by Mukund.
Full and outside off, left alone by the batsman.
This time he comes forward and pushes it towards point.
Shorter around off, punched off the back foot by Dhawan.
Full toss around off, Dhawan comes down the track and looks to go over covers but finds the fielder on the bounce. Crowd catch.
Drops it short, Dhawan goes back and punches it to backward point.
It's gone a bit dark out there.
Floats it around off, Dhawan prods forward and pushes it into covers.
FOUR! Nothing delivery! Too full on middle and leg, Dhawan won't miss out and he clips it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary. False start for Perera!
Dilruwan Perera is called into the attack. The fast bowlers hardly made an impact which has forced Rangana Herath to introduce spin. A slip and short leg in place.
Good length outside off, Mukund gets behind it and defends it towards mid off.
FOUR! Shot! Short and wide outside off, Mukund goes back and punches it through the covers for a boundary. This is too easy for the Indians. Poor plans so far.
Shorter and outside off, punched into covers for a run.

Too full and on the pads, Mukund looks to clip it but fails to do so. Gets rapped on the pads and the bowler appeals, appeals and appeals. Nothing from the umpire as he reckons there was an inside edge. Replays confirm the same.
Mukund looks to defend but gets a soft leading edge into the off side.
Shorter in length on middle, Dhawan taps it with soft hands towards covers and takes a single.
Kumara goes back to over the wicket.
Swing and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Mukund looks to flay it away but fails to connect. A rare bad shot by the Indian opener.
A tad short around off, Mukund comes half-forward and defends it into the covers.
Brings this one into the batsman with the angle, Mukund though covers his stumps and is happy to let it go.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Mukund.
Lands it just outside off on a shorter length, Shikhar taps it into the off side and takes a quick single. Good running!
Change of plan already! Pradeep goes round the wicket, a silly mid on in place.
On a length outside off, Dhawan looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto his back pad.
Shorter in length outside off, Mukund arches back and gets out of the way.
Stays back and keeps this one out.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Mukund defends it watchfully.
Lahiru Kumara to go round the wicket.
FOUR! Poor line! On the pads, Mukund clips it through the square leg region for a boundary. Easy pickings, these.
Back of a length around middle, Mukund defends it towards mid on.
Short and wide outside off, Dhawan lets it go through.
Edged? Maybe. Fullish and in line of the stumps, Dhawan looks to push at it but opens the face of the bat at the last moment to get it through covers for a couple.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Dhawan.
FOUR! Pristine! A tad full and just around off, Dhawan comes forward and just pushes it down the ground through mid off for a boundary. Top shot, really.
Back of a length just outside off, Dhawan taps it towards covers.
Length and angling on middle and leg, Dhawan fails to clip it through. Pradeep is the only one appealing. Think that was going down leg. Replays confirm the same.
Good length outside off, left alone by Dhawan.
Good length outside off, Mukund is not interested.
Similar line, going across the batsman, a confident leave by Abhinav Mukund.
Kumara is trying to get the ball away from Mukund, can he nip one back and surprise the southpaw?
A tad fuller, just outside off, Mukund shoulders his arms to it.
WIDE! An action replay of the previous delivery, but it is even wider and hence a wide is signaled.
Sprays it wide outside off, Mukund is more than happy to let it go.
Slants a length ball outside off, no shot offered.
Short and outside off, played towards point by the batsman.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl from the other end. Similar field for him.
Full and swinging outside off, left alone by Shikhar.
Some issue with the sightscreen, Dhawan is not happy.
On a length just around off, Dhawan comes forward and defends it.
Drifts it on the pads, Mukund clips it through mid-wicket. Herath gives it a chase and keeps the ball in play. Three runs taken. Both openers are off the mark.
Good length around off, Mukund gets behind the line and defends it.
A tad short around off, guided towards point by Mukund.
Hurls a full length ball around off, Dhawan pushes it towards mid off and takes a quick single to get off the mark.
The players are out in the middle! The two Indian openers are Shikhar Dhawan and Abhinav Mukund. Sri Lanka begin with Nuwan Pradeep. He has three slips in place for him. Here we go...
Time for the national anthems!
Seems like the rain has eased off and we should start on time. Fingers crossed.

Sri Lanka skipper, Rangana Herath opines that he would have batted as well. He calls it a good wicket and hopes that they keep the Indians in check. (It started to rain and hence they couldn't talk more). The covers are on now!

India skipper, Virat Kohli informs that he will bat first. Reckons that it looks a pretty hard surface and they will look to make the most of it. Adds that putting runs on the board is always a nice thing. Mentions that Shikhar Dhawan comes in place for KL Rahul who is down with flu. Further says that they are sticking with the same combination with Shami, Umesh, Jadeja, Ashwin and Pandya who is making his Test debut. Ends by saying that he backs his four strike bowlers to do the job for them.
TOSS - India win the toss and elect to bat.

Pitch report - Simon Doull and Russel Arnold feel that the pitch has something for everyone. There are a few dark patches and it may be a bit two-paced. Arnold expects the ball to misbehave. He thinks that the first day will be the best day to bat as batting will get difficult as the game goes on. Team winning the toss should look to bat first.

Sri Lanka on the other hand got out of jail against Zimbabwe. That they chased down a massive total should boost their confidence but they will be aware that India is a different challenge. The onus will be on the seniors to lead from the front. In the absence of Dinesh Chandimal, the hero of that 2015 Test, Rangana Herath will lead the side. Let's see how both teams fare.
